title: Texas refinery diesel-hydrotreater charge pumps: 47% more flow in the installed barrel
source: Sulzer, Reviving Pump Performance, 2020; original BB5 pump duty and project premise only
question: Increase diesel-hydrotreater charge-pump flow from 1,110 to 1,628 gpm at 3,450 ft head while retaining the installed barrel, foundation and piping. What hydraulic and mechanical rerate reaches the target?
data_note: Real refinery BB5 pump rerate. The source publishes before and required flow/head, pump construction and the installed-envelope constraint, but not a fluid assay or full curve. A DWSIM diesel surrogate and efficiency/NPSH curves are explicit assumptions. The impeller, stage and casing modifications are withheld.
suggested_questions: Can the existing barrel pass 1,628 gpm?
How many stages are needed at the lower target head?
Which checks still need the vendor curve and NPSH data?
